description: lib/menu.py imports Budget from lib.quota_tracker creating an implicit module-graph coupling: menu cannot be imported without quota_tracker. This is fine functionally but mixes responsibilities (menu is the picker; budget enum is policy). The verification-architecture lists Budget as a quota_tracker symbol and pick_next as a menu symbol; the budget gate inside pick_next requires both. _BUDGET_RANK has parallel string keys AND enum keys (defensively allowing 'FULL' or Budget.FULL) — that defensive double-key would mask any future regression where a caller passes a string and the enum import drifts.
